intro: With querer and esperar, when the person changes after que, the verb goes in the subjunctive.
p.subjuntivo.consejo: It is a mood, not a tense: the verb changes form when there is a wish or a doubt.
p.querer que.glosa: to want someone to do something
p.querer que.consejo: When the person changes, «querer que» asks for the subjunctive: «quiero que vengas».
p.esperar que.consejo: With another person after it, it also takes the subjunctive: «espero que estés bien».
p.venir.consejo: It is irregular: «vengo» and «vengas». The subjunctive comes from the «yo» form: «vengo» → «vengas».
p.hablar.consejo: An -ar verb: in the subjunctive the a becomes e. «Hablo» gives «hables».
p.estar.consejo: It keeps an accent in the tú subjunctive: «estés». Without it, it would be another word.
p.fiesta.consejo: It is feminine: «la fiesta», «una fiesta». The s is clear: FYES-ta.
p.despacio.consejo: It goes after the verb and never changes: «habla despacio», «hablan despacio».
p.comer.consejo: An -er verb: in the subjunctive the o becomes a. «Como» gives «comas».
p.vivir.consejo: An -ir verb: like «comer», it changes to the vowel a. «Vivo» gives «vivas».
p.invitar.consejo: The v sounds like a b: «in-bi-TAR». You say «invitar a alguien a algo».
p.mismo.consejo: With «tú mismo» or «yo mismo» you stress that it is the same person.
b1.titulo: Same subject or a different subject
b1.texto:
When **you** want to do something, the verb goes in the **infinitive**: **quiero venir**.

When you want **someone else** to do something, you use **que** and the **present subjunctive**: **quiero que vengas**.

- Same subject → **infinitive**: espero llegar pronto.
- Different subject → **que + subjunctive**: espero que llegues pronto.

The subjunctive comes from the **yo** form of the present, changing the vowel: **-ar → e** (hablo → **hable**) and **-er / -ir → a** (como → **coma**, vivo → **viva**).
b2.f0.texto: I want you to come to my sister's party.
b2.f1.texto: I want to go, but I work until eight.
b2.f2.texto: Then I hope you are there at nine.
b2.f3.texto: I will talk to my boss and leave a little earlier.
b2.f4.texto: Marta wants us to eat in the garden.
b2.f5.texto: Do you want me to bring something to eat?
b2.f6.texto: I only want you to speak slowly with my grandmother.
b2.f7.texto: All right, I hope everyone eats well.
b4.texto:
These are the three model verbs, with all six persons:

- **hablar** → hable, hables, hable, hablemos, habléis, hablen
- **comer** → coma, comas, coma, comamos, comáis, coman
- **vivir** → viva, vivas, viva, vivamos, viváis, vivan

The rule is simple: **-ar** verbs use **e** and **-er / -ir** verbs use **a**. Start from the **yo** form: if «yo» is irregular, the subjunctive is too: vengo → **vengas**.

Remember: the person who wants and the person who acts are **different**, and the wish verb comes before **que**.
b4.e0.texto: I want you to speak more slowly.
b4.e1.texto: My parents hope that I live nearby.
b4.e2.texto: My grandmother wants us to eat at her house.
b5.f0.texto: Marta's house smells of warm bread and fresh flowers.
b5.f1.texto: The yellow lights hang from the ceiling like little stars.
b5.f2.texto: Soft music fills the living room with a golden warmth.
b5.f3.texto: On the big table wait the white plates and a lemon tart.
b5.f4.texto: Marta looks at the clock with a nervous smile.
b5.f5.texto: The first guests cross the door with colourful parcels.
b5.f6.texto: Pablo arrives last and leaves his wet coat on a chair.
b5.f7.texto: Lucía hugs him tightly by the window.
b5.f8.texto: Outside, the rain softly taps the dark windowpanes.
b5.f9.texto: Inside, everyone sings an old song around the table.
b6.o0.refuerzo: Well done! The subject is the same: the infinitive goes.
b6.o1.refuerzo: That asks another person to go. You want to go yourself.
b6.o2.refuerzo: «Voy» does not follow «que» with a wish: it needs the subjunctive.
b6.pregunta: You want to go to the party. What do you say?
b7.o0.refuerzo: «Vienes» is the ordinary present. After a wish you need the subjunctive.
b7.o1.refuerzo: Yes! Another person acts, so you need «que» and the subjunctive.
b7.o2.refuerzo: The infinitive only works with a single subject.
b7.pregunta: You ask Pablo to come. Which form is missing?
b8.traduccion: I want you to speak more slowly
b9.o0.refuerzo: «Comes» is the ordinary present, with e.
b9.o1.refuerzo: That form does not exist. With «tú» it ends in -as.
b9.o2.refuerzo: That's it! Verbs in -er change to the vowel a.
b9.pregunta: What is the subjunctive of «comer» for tú?
b10.o0.refuerzo: Correct: «vivir» changes to the vowel a in the subjunctive.
b10.o1.refuerzo: «Vivo» is the ordinary present, with no wish.
b10.o2.refuerzo: That word does not exist: the verb is «vivir».
b10.pregunta: My parents wish something of me. Which form is missing?
b11.pregunta: Write in Spanish: «I want you to speak slowly» (tú).
p.vengas.consejo: Subjunctive of «venir» for tú. It comes from «vengo»: «vengo» → «vengas».
p.espero.consejo: «Esperar» means both to hope and to wait. Context tells you which: «espero que…» is hope.
p.estés.consejo: Subjunctive of «estar» for tú. The accent keeps the stress on the last syllable.
p.comamos.consejo: Subjunctive of «comer» for nosotros. It has no accent: the stress is on the second-to-last syllable.
p.lleve.consejo: Subjunctive of «llevar» for yo or él. The ll sounds like y: «YE-be».
p.abuela.consejo: The h is silent and the b sounds soft: «a-BWE-la». Her husband is «el abuelo».
p.coman.consejo: Subjunctive of «comer» for ellos or ustedes. The a replaces the e of «comen».
p.viva.consejo: Subjunctive of «vivir» for yo or él. The v sounds like b: «BI-ba».
p.techo.consejo: It is the ceiling inside and the roof outside. The ch sounds like in «chocolate».
p.blancos.consejo: Plural of «blanco». It must agree with the noun: «platos blancos», «mesas blancas».
p.invitados.consejo: From «invitar». The v sounds like b: «im-bi-TA-dos». A woman is «una invitada».
p.cruzan.consejo: The z sounds th: «KRU-than». The infinitive is «cruzar»; before e it becomes «cruce».
p.paquetes.consejo: The qu sounds k: «pa-KE-tes». The singular is «paquete».
p.último.consejo: The accent is on the first syllable: «ÚL-ti-mo». «Llegar el último» is to arrive last.
p.mojado.consejo: The j sounds h: «mo-HA-do». It comes from «mojar», to make wet.
p.suavemente.consejo: It is «suave» + «-mente». The v sounds b: «swa-be-MEN-te».
p.cristales.consejo: Plural of «cristal». The accent disappears because the stress now falls on the second-to-last syllable.
p.comas.consejo: Subjunctive of «comer» for tú. Do not mix it up with «comes» (present).
